title: Zoom - Zoom Conference Room Connector DNS Changes: November 14, 2026 (No Operational Impact)
text:
Service: Zoom
Maintenance: Zoom Conference Room Connector DNS Changes: November 14, 2026 (No Operational Impact)
Status: scheduled
Impact: maintenance
Scheduled for: 2026-11-13T19:30:00.000-08:00
Scheduled until: 2026-11-14T11:30:00.000-08:00
Updates:
- 2026-10-09T10:27:26.172-07:00: scheduled - As part of ongoing service enhancements for the Cloud Room Connector (CRC) service, Zoom will be updating DNS records for SIP/H.323 endpoints in the Japan (Osaka and Tokyo), EU (France and Amsterdam), Australia (Melbourne and Sydney), Hong Kong, China, Canada (Toronto and Vancouver), and India (Mumbai and Hyderabad) regions.

In addition to the DNS record update, we will be decommissioning legacy DNS records in other regions that are no longer in use.

 Effective Date : November 14, 2026

 Action Required 
To avoid service disruption, we recommend reviewing your CRC endpoint configurations as soon as possible, updating your DNS records with the new entries, and removing the older legacy records before November 14, 2026. 

If you have any questions or issues, please contact Zoom Support.

 DNS Record Updates 

 Japan Region 
We will update the country-level domain and data-center (DC) domains, along with their respective SRV-Records. An example of the change is as follows:

zmjp.us >> jp.zoomcrc.com
os.zmjp.us >> kix.zoomcrc.com
ty.zmjp.us >> nrt.zoomcrc.com
